title: UMass Boston shuttle: JFK/UMass <-> Campus Center
content: The UMass Boston campus shuttle runs continuously between JFK/UMass T station and the Campus Center on weekdays during the academic year. Shuttles depart every 5-10 minutes from approximately 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. The one-way trip takes about 6-8 minutes including loading. On weekends and holidays, service runs every 15-20 minutes from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

title: UMass Boston shuttle: Bayside Lot <-> Campus
content: The Bayside Lot shuttle runs between the off-campus Bayside parking lot and the main UMass Boston campus on weekdays during the academic year. Shuttles depart every 10-15 minutes from approximately 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM. One-way trip takes about 5 minutes.
